owner_access_path: checkRole (src/http/binding.ts) now takes a `pool: pg.Pool` parameter. In keycloak auth mode, before the process_designer role_assignment lookup, it calls `isGenesisOwnerForTenant(pool, tenantId, actorSlug, Date.now())` and returns early (bypass) if true. isGenesisOwnerForTenant (src/db/org.ts:721) is POST-T-0658: its inner slug->employee subquery carries `AND deactivated_at IS NULL` (confirmed by reading the function's own T-0658 doc-comment and by the existing ci/checks/db/org-admin-deactivation.db.test.ts, which stayed green through this change) — deactivation is inherited, not reopened. No new employee-lookup was written; this is the fifth authority path (per T-0658's own enumeration), not a sixth.

friction_events: floor1-editor.test.ts's existing makeStubPool() returned {rows:[{cnt:roleCount}]} for ANY query containing 'role_assignment' — after adding the isGenesisOwnerForTenant call (which ALSO queries role_assignment, keyed on r.slug='tenant-owner'), the stub could not distinguish the two queries, causing 2 pre-existing tests (AC-27, AC-29's missing-role case) to flip from 403 to 200 (a non-empty stub row for cnt:0 still satisfies isGenesisOwnerForTenant's `rows.length > 0` check). Fixed by branching the stub on the literal 'tenant-owner' vs the process_designer query shape, with an explicit isOwner parameter (default false) so existing callers keep their original behavior unless they opt in.
